markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (63%)** · Ambiguous: Benign vs InSitu · Careful review
InSitu holds 36% and sits in the 90% conformal set; invasive is 1% [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 63%, InSitu 36%, Invasive 1% | Benign leads, InSitu close |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu | Cannot separate the two |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.90 / 68th percentile | Input looks typical |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 4 of 5 Benign | Supports Benign |

## Tissue evidence
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 0, 1, 2) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; associated with lower invasive likelihood [F2] · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 4, 5, 6) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; associated with non-invasive disease [F4] · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Near typical; no clear invasive signal · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Below typical; no pleomorphism signal · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate** (region 3) · context · Below typical; weak spot check (8/20) [F3] · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions cuts the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (−0.005 to 0.007), so not shown to reflect classifier use; lymphocytes Weak.

## Could be wrong if
- InSitu (36%) cannot be excluded; Benign versus InSitu is unresolved at 90%.
- The duct-confined score is only Weak (12/20), so atypia cues may be misread.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 4, 5, 6**: atypical duct-confined cells versus benign hyperplasia.
2. **Regions 9, 10**: highest invasive-direction contribution; confirm no stromal invasion.
3. **Regions 0, 1, 2**: confirm glands are benign, not atypical.
